gui.assortedlib.manual.chapter_missing: This chapter is no longer part of the book.
gui.assortedlib.manual.index.empty: Nothing has been written yet. Install one of the Assorted mods and its chapters appear here.
gui.assortedlib.manual.index.intro:
Every Assorted mod you have installed writes its own part of this book.

Pick a mod from the main page to see what it adds, then pick a chapter to read it.

Out in the world, right click a block, item or creature with the manual and it opens straight to that page.
gui.assortedlib.manual.recipe_undrawable: This recipe cannot be drawn here.
gui.assortedlib.manual.title: Instruction Manual
manual.assortedlib.chapter.reading.craft: A book, a piece of leather to bind it and any dye for the ink.
manual.assortedlib.chapter.reading.marks:
A slot ringed in gold takes any one of several things, and cycles through them. This usually means just the item tag that the recipe consists of.

Two crossed arrows in the top-right corner mean the pieces go in any arrangement and the recipe is Shapeless.

Hovering your cursor on a recipe and it stops cycling while you read.
manual.assortedlib.chapter.reading.point:
Right click anything with the manual and it opens to that page, if it has one. Blocks, dropped items and creatures all work.

An item drawn on a page is a link. Click it and the book turns to what it is.

The arrows at the corners turn the page, and step back out to the chapters and the index.
manual.assortedlib.chapter.reading.recip:
A recipe is drawn on the screen of whatever makes it, so crafting looks like a crafting table and smelting like a furnace.

The slots a container always has are drawn too. For example a furnace shows its fuel.
manual.assortedlib.description: This first section is about the book in your hands.
manual.assortedlib.title: The Manual
